manual.assortedlightoverlay.chapter.ligh:
Press the key default "F7" to show the block light on the ground around you.

Red is where a monster can spawn at any time, yellow where one can only at night or a storm, and green where one never can.
manual.assortedlightoverlay.description: A key that shows the light level wherever a monster could spawn.
manual.assortedlightoverlay.title: Assorted Light Overlay
